Remove grain from every image while keeping edges.

Non-local means (OpenCV fastNlMeansDenoisingColored; fastNlMeansDenoising for grey images). Slow: about 45 ms an image at 64 x 64, so it is worth doing once. Done once when the images are prepared: OpenCV on the CPU workers, in canvas order with the other steps done once; every epoch reads the result. Same result in training, validation and test.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Image Denoise -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Done once when the images are prepared (OpenCV, CPU), in canvas order before the first random step. Runs in training, validation and test.
```

## Tips

- Noisy camera or low-light images.
- About 45 ms an image at 64 x 64: preparing takes minutes, once.
